title: Road-trip roadblocks, closed and opening
prompt: A sheet of eight blocky voxel roadblocks across a highway, each shown twice side by side, closed and in the middle of opening: a burning wrecked Greyhound bus (the fire dies and it is towed aside); a wall of grey stone statues (they crumble to rubble); a raised lift bridge (it lowers); a mudslide of rock and mud (it slides away); a gate of glowing neon lotus vines (they wither); a barricade of stacked waterbeds (they deflate); a wall of swirling black shadow (it parts like curtains); a sea storm breaking over the road (the sky clears). Clear and readable from above. 3D game art in the blocky voxel style of Minecraft Dungeons: characters built from cubes, with a large cube head whose face is simple pixel art (about 8 × 8 pixels: pixel eyes, a pixel mouth, hair drawn as pixels and as a few blocky tufts), a boxy torso, square arms and legs, crisp pixel-art textures (about 16 pixels per block) with simple shading, chunky readable silhouettes; warm cinematic lighting, soft ambient occlusion and glowing magic effects. Costume colours and details follow the Camp Half-Blood cartoon concept art. Palette: camp orange #f28c28, sea teal #0f6f73, deep navy #10233d, jade #2e8b6e, coral #e8664a, bronze gold #c9963a, lightning yellow #ffd84a, parchment cream #f4ead5, vase black #17130f and owl grey #8c96a3. Flat light-grey background. No lettering, logos, captions or watermark.
generation_prompt:
